notes.title: Miscelaneous fixes
notes.content:
- Fix Beralt and Mauber shotguns. Now they shouldn't get jammed anymore and only one reload is needed to replenish the magazine.
- Fix Sinden Border not displacing UI initializing correctly when a game starts.
- Remove level up screen showing diamonds, as this currency does not exists on Steam.

notes.title: Fast reloads and outer border option added
notes.content:
Reloads are super fast now.
Also, our great testers noticed that inside black border is not useful with Sinden Lightgun, so we've inverted it to be outside.
You also have an option to turn on or off the black border.

notes.title: Lightgun Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Removed Slow motion when disarming enemies.
[*]Fix shooting outside to reload: Shooting outside the screen now triggers reload.
[*]Add black Sinden border: Gives more accuracy to Sinden Lightgun screen detection
[*]Add more inputs and remove screen buttons: Now common shooter buttons like [b]TAB[/b], [b]Q[/b], [b]1[/b], [b]2[/b], [b]mouse scroll[/b] change weapons. [b]R[/b] reloads the wepon and [b]ESC[/b] pauses. All button clicks were removed to improve shooting at the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Add Sinden Border option
notes.content:
Sinden Lightgun users can use the embedded whit border.
This option conforms all game UI inside the borders, so it's a better fit for Sinden Lightgun users than the one that comes with the driver.

notes.title: Add crosshair option
notes.content: Sinden Lightgun users were asking for this one, so here it is! 👍

notes.title: Improve character and scene textures and materials
notes.content: I've visited material and texture settings and improved them to better suit Steam users
